newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, distant months lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, distant months lower.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Friday as technical selling by individual investors erased earlier price gains, local traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract ended down 10 yen at 16,210 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 63,701 lots.
All contracts were higher at the opening, due to the stronger Chicago corn market overnight, traders said.

But weaker sentiment in CBOT Project A trading discouraged investors, and distant months were sold by early afternoon, traders said. "Investors failed to find a clear direction today," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.03 per bushel at 0735 GMT, against $3.04-3/4 at Thursday's close.
The spot March CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.45 at 0735 GMT, down from $8.52 at Thursday's close.
